rows.description: Aqara MCCGQ11LM Zigbee door/window contact sensor (body plus magnet)

liveness_check.how: A home-automation automation on last_seen, plus a battery-level alert. A dead Zigbee sensor fails silently: without that automation you would simply stop getting reminders and never find out why - and the failure looks exactly like remembering to take your medication.

rows.notes: Self-powered from its own CR1632. It contributes nothing to a power budget, which is why this project legitimately skips phase 3 rather than inventing one. The cell is in a screwless snap shell, so the design must never trap the sensor.

rows.description: Neodymium block magnet, 20 x 10 x 3 mm, N35
rows.notes: The vendor's own magnet works, but is awkward to mount in a printed lid. A bare block magnet in a pocket is easier and the release distance is unchanged as long as the pole faces the sensor's marked face. Glue it: a magnet that falls out of a lid pocket is a sensor that reports the box permanently open.
